settings.title: Why Homeowners Choose A-DIY

The First Contractor-Grade DIY Deck Kit. Available in Every State.


A-DIY was founded to solve a problem that had stayed unsolved for a long time. Homeowners across the country wanted beautiful, durable outdoor decks, but the process of getting one had always felt complicated. A-DIY created a genuinely new option, a pre-cut, patent-pending modular deck kit that delivers professional-grade results for any homeowner willing to pick up a drill and give it an afternoon.

We ship pre-engineered deck kits with all components pre-cut and numbered, all hardware included, and a step-by-step assembly guide. A single drill is the only tool required. Customers regularly complete mid-size decks in a day and report an average savings of $5,000 to $8,000 compared to the quotes they received for the same footprint.

settings.text:
Permit requirements for decks vary significantly across the US. Here's what our customers encounter most often, regardless of where they're building:

  • Ground-level floating decks under 30 inches typically require no permit in most jurisdictions, but always confirm directly with your local building department before starting.

  • Elevated decks usually trigger permit requirements when attached to the home or exceeding a height threshold that varies by municipality.

  • HOA communities often have their own approval process separate from city permits. It's worth checking both before placing your order.

  • Permit timelines vary widely, from same-week approvals in smaller towns to several weeks in larger cities. A-DIY provides engineering diagrams to support your application on request.

  • Some cities waive permits for kits under a certain square footage. Our design team can help you stay within that threshold.

  • Reach out to your local building department, then book a free consultation with our team. We've helped hundreds of customers navigate this process and will walk you through it step by step.

settings.content:
Choose Your Kit

settings.title: Everything You Need to Know Before You Build A Deck in The USA

settings.label: Do you deliver DIY deck kits to my state?
settings.content: Yes. A-DIY ships to all 48 contiguous US states. We do not currently ship to Alaska or Hawaii. Every kit arrives with free delivery to your home address.

settings.label: Do I need a building permit to install a deck?
settings.content: Permit requirements vary by city, county, and state. Many jurisdictions require a permit for decks over a certain height or square footage. We recommend checking with your local municipality before starting. Our design consultants can also help guide you.

settings.label: Which material is right for my climate?
settings.content: Composite decking is ideal for humid, coastal, and high-UV regions like Florida, California, and Texas. Kiln-dried pressure-treated wood is a great fit for colder northern states like Minnesota, Michigan, and New Hampshire.

settings.label: How much can I really save vs. hiring a contractor?
settings.content: Local deck contractors in most US cities charge between $8,000 and $25,000+, depending on size and materials. A-DIY deck kit prices are up to 40% cheaper because you only pay for materials, not labor. Many customers report saving $5,000 to $12,000 on a single build.

settings.label: What tools do I actually need?
settings.content: Just a standard hand drill. That's it. Our patent-pending system is engineered so that every component fits precisely, every time, like the world's most satisfying LEGO set.

settings.label: Can I get help with design and sizing before ordering?
settings.content: Absolutely. Our free design consultation service connects you with a senior A-DIY design consultant who will review your space, recommend the right kit size, and walk you through material options completely free, with zero obligation to buy.

settings.label: What is the warranty on A-DIY deck kits?
settings.content: All A-DIY kits include a 5-year structural warranty. Composite decking kits include an additional 25-year composite material warranty. Our products are built to last and we stand behind every kit we ship.

settings.label: Is financing available?
settings.content: Yes. A-DIY offers flexible financing starting at $0 down and 0% interest for up to 24 months, subject to credit approval. You can start building your dream deck today and pay over time.
